title: columnea nervosa

This plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its numerous health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the plant, such as rutin and quercetin, are believed to be responsible for its calming and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential natural remedy for stress-related disorders.
